name: STAMPD.IO – Blockchain Stamping
author: stampdio

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to stamp the contents of your posts to the blockchain. Protect the authenticity of your original work by timestamping the unique identifier (SHA256 hash) of each posts’s content.

Using this plugin you can stamp your posts and add a custom signature with the resulting hash and transaction ID.

Learn more about it and how it works: https://stampd.io/#/about

It requires that you have an account in stampd.io. Visit this URL to register: https://stampd.io/#/register
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and PHP 8.3.
  • The API secret key is sent in the request body instead of the URL.
  • Requests use the WordPress HTTP API with timeouts.
  • A failed stamp is no longer sent a second time.
  • Showing or hiding the signature now needs a valid nonce and edit rights on the post.
  • Output escaping and a guard for content filters run outside the loop.

Earlier versions

  • Minor corrections for WordPress 6.
  • Post content fix.
  • Updates to the UI.
  • Minor JS fix.
  • Updated for use with Gutenberg blocks.
  • Initial submission.
